worldcombat.skill.visegrip.summary: Step in and close two real pincer paths on the first enemy for one squeeze. A body that accepts the grip is held for up to six ticks; Haul backs away and draws it along. Distance, walls or interruption release it, while grab-resistant bodies take only the strike.
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.use.0: Yank a fleeing target back into melee
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.use.1: Land a solid contact hit on a target smaller than your pincers
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.use.2: Briefly draw a nearby opponent away from its group
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.use.3: A short, cheap physical tool at close quarters
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.description.0: The first enemy contacted by the real claws takes %1$s power within %2$s blocks; walls stop the claws.
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.description.1: Approach up to %2$s blocks. An accepted grip lasts six ticks: Haul backs away within the original %1$s-block drag budget, while Crush tightens in place.
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.haul.on: Drag on: the target is hauled about ×1.35 closer with a slightly longer reach, at about ×0.9 damage, to pull foes into an ally's range.
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.haul.off: Drag off (Grind): about ×1.18 damage with only a short tug (about ×0.65 drag).
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.timing: Cast at a target within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s-second prepare it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s seconds; cooldown %5$s seconds from commit.
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.growth.0: At level %1$s, pincer power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.preference.ha: On: the target is hauled about ×1.35 closer with a slightly longer reach, at about ×0.9 damage, to drag foes into an ally's range. Off (Grind): about ×1.18 damage with only a short tug (about ×0.65 drag).
worldcombat.skill.visegrip.preference.ai: The companion only clamps while a target is within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
Wounded targets only skips foes above 60%% health, saving the pull to finish a hurt target.
